name: Melopo Duplicate Cleaner
author: Luis Peel

sections.description:
Melopo Duplicate Cleaner helps you find and remove duplicate content across posts, pages and any Custom Post Type — quickly, safely and without touching your live content until you say so.

Free features:

  • Detect duplicates in Posts and Pages by exact title or slug
  • Grouped results view — see all duplicates at a glance
  • Preview modal before deleting — see content, image, and metadata first
  • Bulk actions: Move to Trash or Change to Draft
  • Whitelist posts you want to keep (excluded from future scans)
  • Action log — track every change with date, user, and post info
  • Filters by post type and status

Pro features:

  • Scan any Custom Post Type
  • Title similarity detection with configurable threshold (70 % – 95 %)
  • Permanent deletion with automatic 301 redirects
  • Scheduled automatic scans (daily / weekly / monthly) via WP-Cron
  • Email notifications when new duplicates are found
  • Export logs to CSV
  • Unlimited log retention
sections.installation:
1. Upload the melopo-duplicate-cleaner folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Duplicate Posts in the main WordPress admin menu to start scanning.
sections.faq:
Will it delete my posts without confirmation?

No. The plugin always shows a confirmation dialog before any destructive action. You can also preview each post before deciding.

Does it support custom post types?

Yes — full CPT support is available in the Pro version. With Pro you can scan any registered public Custom Post Type (WooCommerce products, portfolio entries, team members, etc.). In the free version, Posts and Pages are always scanned; CPT options are visible in the filter so you can see what’s available before upgrading.

Is it compatible with WooCommerce?

Yes — the plugin does not modify the frontend or WooCommerce data. It only operates inside the WordPress admin.

Is it safe to use on a live site?

Yes. The free plan moves posts to Trash (recoverable) rather than deleting them permanently. Permanent deletion is a Pro-only feature.
